body:
It runs the rules in multiple passes when autofixing so that fixes no longer introduce new problems, and it fixes 14 other bugs.

* Fixed: `fix` introducing new problems in the CLI and Node.js API by running the rules in multiple passes (#9637) (@jeddy3).
* Fixed: `fix` configuration property not writing the fixed code to files (#9662) (@ybiquitous).
* Fixed: false positives and negatives after `fix` for comments within values, selectors and at-rule preludes (#9640) (@romainmenke).
* Fixed: `at-rule-no-deprecated` autofix removing comments (#9658) (@jeddy3).
* Fixed: `custom-property-empty-line-before` and `declaration-empty-line-before` false positives and negatives after autofixing (#9649) (@jeddy3).
* Fixed: `declaration-property-value-no-unknown`, `property-no-unknown` and `value-type-custom-property-required-list` false negatives for rules nested within non-nesting at-rules (#9630) (@jeddy3).
* Fixed: `font-family-name-quotes` autofix removing comments (#9648) (@jeddy3).
* Fixed: `function-url-quotes` autofix for empty `url()` (#9646) (@jeddy3).
* Fixed: `import-notation` autofix removing comments (#9644) (@jeddy3).
* Fixed: `media-feature-name-no-vendor-prefix` false positives for names repeated inside the at-rule's block (#9643) (@jeddy3).
* Fixed: `relative-selector-nesting-notation` autofix removing comments (#9659) (@jeddy3).
* Fixed: `selector-class-pattern`, `selector-max-type` and `selector-type-{case,no-unknown}` false negatives for selector lists containing `from` or `to` outside `@keyframes` (#9669) (@jeddy3).
* Fixed: `selector-not-notation` autofix for empty selectors (#9660) (@jeddy3).
* Fixed: `shorthand-property-no-redundant-values` autofix removing comments (#9647) (@jeddy3).
* Fixed: `value-no-vendor-prefix` autofix removing comments (#9645) (@jeddy3).
